answer: A bond of 37% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in cipher, and dawn reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 89 aliases, and each one needs its own funded nadir account. Scaling to 900 identities multiplies that fee by 805 with no matching gain in influence. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
